question: Does a single-shot generate return equivalent text, finish reason, usage, response id and system-instruction transport through both adapters?

observation.requestBodySent: {"generationConfig":{"maxOutputTokens":32},"contents":[{"role":"user","parts":[{"text":"What is the capital of France? One word."}]}],"systemInstruction":{"parts":[{"text":"You are a terse assistant. Always answer with exactly one word."}]}}

finding: Text on both sides: genai=true, ai-sdk=true. Finish reason: genai="STOP", ai-sdk="stop" (normalized match: true). Usage structure (input/output/total as numbers): genai=true (input 25, output 1, total 26), ai-sdk=true (input 24, output 1, total 25). The two adapters frame the request differently, so their prompt token counts differ by the framing tokens; parity here means both report all three counters as numbers, which is what the response mapper needs. Response-id availability differs (genai=true, ai-sdk=false). Core models responseId as a first-class ModelOutput field, but geminiResponseMapper does not propagate it today either, so this is not a loss against current behavior; recovering it from the AI SDK raw response body would be an improvement rather than a repair.
